name: MOSO Bamboo Canada
source: MOSO's brand.css (clients/moso/brand.css). MOSO has its own locked system, not a shared template.

dev.label: Website Head code: site CSS (after GTM)
Website Body code: scripts (after GTM noscript)

classes.name: Text
classes.where: Put on the Headline, Paragraph or Bullet List element.

items.name: bullet-points
items.does: Small green bullet dots (on a Bullet List).

items.name: bold-black
items.does: Bold black text, for a small line that needs to stand out.

items.name: bold-white
items.does: Bold white text, for a small line on a dark background.

items.name: on-dark
items.does: White H3 on a dark background.

items.name: font-override
items.does: Escape hatch: lets this one element use its own font, size or colour.

items.name: btn-primary
items.does: Green pill button, darker green on hover.

items.name: btn-outline
items.does: Black outline button, fills black on hover.

items.name: btn-group
items.does: Holds buttons side by side and wraps them on small screens (put on their container).

items.name: img-lightbox
items.does: Click to open the image full screen.

classes.name: Sections and columns
classes.where: Put on a Section, Row or Column.

items.name: new-hero
items.does: All text inside turns white (hero sections).

items.name: project-details
items.does: All text inside turns white (dark sections).

items.name: bg-lightbox
items.does: Click the column to open its background image full screen.

items.name: moso-social-row
items.does: Lays the footer social icons out side by side, centred.
